project_name: BDS Marvel Stays - Mobile Experience Blueprint

brand_identity.name: BDS Marvel Stays
brand_identity.positioning: Luxury Marble & Stone Studio with Boutique Stays across India
brand_identity.tone: Tactile Architectural Elegance, Warm Paper Texture, Crisp Ink Typography, Fine Gold Accents
brand_identity.color_archetype: Luxury Organic & Earthy (Cream Paper, Ink Black, Milled Gold)
brand_identity.design_philosophy: Combine Airbnb's intuitive mobile UX patterns with BDS Marvel's bespoke luxury stone & architectural studio aesthetic.

scale.h1_hero: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-serif font-medium tracking-tight leading-tight
scale.h2_section: text-xl sm:text-2xl font-serif font-medium tracking-tight text-[#0d0b09]
scale.caption: text-xs font-sans text-[#6f685c]
scale.pill_label: text-xs font-sans font-semibold tracking-wider uppercase text-[#0d0b09]

rules: Do NOT use Inter or Arial for main or section headings.
Use Cormorant Garamond font for all section titles, hero headings, and search step headings.
Use Outfit for body text, numbers, buttons, guest counters, and filter tags.
Apply tracking-tight to headings above 20px to prevent loose kerning on mobile screens.

semantics.guest_favorite_badge: bg-[#0d0b09] text-[#f4efe6] or bg-[#fffdf8] text-[#0d0b09] with 1px border
semantics.price_pill_map: bg-[#fffdf8] text-[#0d0b09] border 1px border-[#e3dbcc] shadow-md hover:bg-[#0d0b09] hover:text-[#f4efe6]

rules: FORBIDDEN COLOR: Do not use teal green (#1B93A4) or harsh electric purple (#7351B7).
All text must satisfy WCAG AA contrast (min 4.5:1 for body, 3:1 for large display).
Explicitly specify text colors on hover states e.g. hover:bg-[#0d0b09] hover:text-[#f4efe6].

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#fffdf8]/90 border-b border-[#e3dbcc] for sticky top headers and float bars
visual_enhancers.sheet_scrim: bg-[#0d0b09]/50 backdrop-blur-xs for modal/sheet backdrop overlays
visual_enhancers.bento_elevation: nested radii: child border-radius (12px) <= parent border-radius (20px)
visual_enhancers.texture: subtle grain background styling on cream surfaces to preserve high-end paper tactile feel

mobile_top_search_bar.description: Floating rounded search pill at top of mobile home feed & search results
mobile_top_search_bar.structure: Flex container with magnifying glass icon on left, 2-line stacked text (Where in bold top, Dates + Guests in muted bottom), right filter icon or go button
mobile_top_search_bar.styling: border: 1px solid #e3dbcc, border-radius: 999px, bg: #fffdf8, padding: 10px 18px, shadow: 0 4px 18px rgba(13,11,9,0.08)

category_chips_row.description: Horizontal scrollable stay tiers bar (All, Premium, Mid, Budget-friendly)
category_chips_row.styling: gap: 20px, scrollbar-width: none, overflow-x: auto, item padding: 8px 14px, bottom active border-b-2 border-[#c9a262]
category_chips_row.icons: Sparkles for All, Crown for Premium, Home for Mid, Leaf for Budget-friendly

stay_card_horizontal_track.description: Horizontal snap-scroll listing cards for mobile home feed sections
elements: Image carousel or static hero photo
Guest Favorite pill badge at top-left: 'Guest favorite' with laurel/star icon
Heart favorite toggle button at top-right with gold/ink transition
Location & Stay Type in serif / semi-bold sans: e.g. 'Gurgaon District · Villa'
Star rating with review count: e.g. '★ 4.96 (24)'
Price line: '₹22,500 / night' with tax inclusive disclaimer note

mobile_search_sheet.description: Full-screen stepped search sheet with Accordion or Tab steps (Where, When, Who)

where_step.title: Where to?
where_step.search_input: Full width rounded text input with autofocus and search icon
where_step.nearby_button: Pill / Card option 'Nearby - Use my current location' with location target icon
where_step.suggested_destinations: List of cities/states with stay counts and map pin icons

when_step.title: When's your trip?
when_step.calendar: Single-month RangeCalendar optimized for mobile touch targets (44px min touch cell)

who_step.title: Who's coming?
who_step.stepper_rows: Adults, Children, Infants, Pets rows with age subtitles and circular [-] / [+] steppers
who_step.counter_style: Circular buttons (36px x 36px) with 1px solid line, disabled opacity when limit reached

footer.styling: Sticky bottom bar with flex space-between, 'Clear all' underline link on left, primary 'Search' gold button on right

mobile_map_and_results.description: Mobile map view with price pills and sliding bottom sheet drawer
mobile_map_and_results.price_pill_markers: Pill buttons showing '₹X,XXX', dark background when selected, white background with gold/ink border when inactive
mobile_map_and_results.floating_toggle_button: Pill at bottom center 'Show map' / 'Show list' with Map/List icon, z-index: 600, background: #0d0b09, text: #f4efe6
mobile_map_and_results.preview_card: Floating preview card above bottom screen when map pin is tapped

bottom_navigation_bar.description: Optional mobile web footer bar for quick discovery / saved stays access
bottom_navigation_bar.styling: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 h-16 bg-[#fffdf8]/95 backdrop-blur-md border-t border-[#e3dbcc] z-50 flex justify-around items-center

grids.horizontal_snap_track: flex gap-4 overflow-x-auto snap-x snap-mandatory scrollbar-none pb-2

layouts.modal_sheet: fixed inset-0 z-[1000] flex flex-col justify-end sm:justify-center bg-[#0d0b09]/50

motion.page_transition: initial: { opacity: 0, y: 8 }, animate: { opacity: 1, y: 0 }, exit: { opacity: 0 }, transition: { duration: 0.22 }
motion.modal_sheet_slide: initial: { y: '100%' }, animate: { y: 0 }, exit: { y: '100%' }, transition: { type: 'spring', damping: 28, stiffness: 280 }
motion.accordion_expand: initial: { height: 0, opacity: 0 }, animate: { height: 'auto', opacity: 1 }, exit: { height: 0, opacity: 0 }, transition: { duration: 0.22 }

accessibility.touch_targets: Minimum 44px x 44px for all mobile interactive buttons, stepper controls, and day cells
accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Escape key closes sheets, Tab cycle trapped within active modal
accessibility.aria_labels: All icon-only buttons require explicit aria-label e.g. aria-label='Increase adults count'
accessibility.data_testid_requirements: All testids must be preserved: search-mobile-pill, search-sheet, search-sheet-where, search-sheet-when, search-sheet-who, search-sheet-clear, search-sheet-submit, toggle-map, map-preview, row-saved, row-{tier_slug}, open-filters, filters-modal

media.border_radius: rounded-[16px] for cards and map preview, rounded-[999px] for pills and search inputs
media.image_optimization: use img(url, width) helper to load optimized images for mobile screens
media.fallbacks: show gradient skeleton (.sx-skel) while imagery or availability loads

hero_stays.description: Modern Stone Villa with Private Pool

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Review stays.css: Update mobile styles (@media max-width 768px) to align search pills, category chips, section titles, card tracks, and sheet modals with the warm paper & gold theme.
2. Restyle SearchBar.jsx on mobile: Ensure search-mobile-pill displays destination prominently in Cormorant Garamond / Outfit weight, with dates & guests below.

3. Refine Modal in ui.jsx & SearchBar.jsx: Make full-screen search sheet render smooth accordion steps (Where, When, Who) with Cormorant Garamond step titles, generous padding, and clear sticky footers.
4. Enhance RangeCalendar in ui.jsx: Single month display on mobile with 44px round day cells, gold range highlight background, and clear weekday headers.
5. Update StaysHome.jsx: Ensure category bar scrolls horizontally with smooth indicators, stay rows scroll with snap-x padding, and section titles use Cormorant Garamond font.
6. Update StaysSearch.jsx: Enhance filter bar horizontal chips, map full-screen view with custom price pills, floating 'Show map' button, and slide-up map card preview.
7. Do NOT remove or modify any existing data-testid attributes.
8. Ensure all touch targets are at least 44px x 44px on touch viewports.

anti_patterns: No default un-styled select boxes or browser native pickers.
No stark pure white backgrounds over dark elements without border contrast.
No missing data-testid tags on interactive elements.
No broken mobile layouts with horizontal scroll overflows outside designated tracks.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.testing_compliance: Ensure all interactive buttons, steppers, date cells, search sheet triggers, filter triggers, and navigation links maintain their exact data-testid strings.
